params.prompt: Create a single premium architectural cinema keyframe, photorealistic enough to pass for a large-format camera photograph. This is one location photographed from a new camera position, not a redesign of the reference. Reference 1 establishes the actual fixed space: a monumental suspended red tessellated A in a wet concrete forecourt, one rectangular reinforced-concrete entrance portal, a ribbed reinforcement cage on the right, and a contemporary multi-storey reinforced concrete frame behind. Maintain those physical relationships, construction scale and blue-hour lighting. Reference 2 is the ORIGINAL ADDUCO logo identity: preserve the A silhouette, its open center, the separate inner triangle, triangular panel layout and distinctly different dark burgundy, crimson and scarlet faces. Render the emblem as thick bolted enamelled steel, suspended on taut steel chains, with believable welds and restrained wear. No lettering from the logo reference. Extremely detailed poured concrete with formwork impressions, tie holes, mineral grain, damp patches and subtle edge chips; authentic rebar ribs, steel ties and fasteners. Grounded structural engineering: slabs rest on beams and upright supports. Wet ground and shallow uneven reflections, cool overcast evening sky and restrained warm construction strip lights, natural photographic exposure with visible midtone texture. Deep architectural focus, no stylized CGI, plastic smoothness, cartoon, fog wall, exaggerated bloom, people, plants, classical columns, UI, text, watermarks or invented brands. Landscape 16:9; the left 30% has quiet darker negative space for real HTML typography later, without a artificial flat black panel. ANCHOR 01 / ENTRY. Camera at 0.6m above the forecourt, 28mm tilt-corrected cinema lens. Red reflected light on wet concrete leads the eye to the WHOLE suspended A in the middle-right, entirely visible with breathing room above and below. Emblem about 42% of image height, monumental against the portal, full multi-storey structure in background. Right side reveals a physically open route past the A toward the reinforcement cage. Elegant low perspective, real contact shadows and immense weight. Do not make the sculpture so large that it crops or covers all of the building.

An unbroken eight-second hyperreal architectural cinema camera move between the EXACT supplied start and end photographs. Treat both images as photographs of ONE rigid construction site. Only the camera moves; the building, concrete portal, reinforcement cage, steel chains and single red tessellated A remain rigid and fixed in space. Preserve the A's original silhouette, separate inner triangular piece, panel triangulation and distinct burgundy/crimson/scarlet shades; no second A, no morphing or reassembly. Preserve supported slabs, concrete surface detail, bolts, rebar ribs and warm strip lighting with cool blue-hour sky. Powerful restrained motion-control photography, natural perspective and foreground parallax. Travel through open air around obstacles, never through walls, beams, slabs or the sculpture. No cuts, dissolves, optical zoom, shaking, focus pumping, text, UI or audio. Slow gently near both ends so adjacent shots can connect. Frame-by-frame photographic realism with coherent materials, nuanced reflections and exposure, no fake CGI sheen. SHOT 1 / ENTRY TO MATERIAL. Start low over wet concrete looking at the suspended A. Dolly gradually forward and slide RIGHT toward the right-side reinforcement cage, rising only from 0.6m to 1.4m. Finish beside the rough concrete upright and ribbed rebar, which fills the right foreground while the same A recedes to the left in the background. Create one continuous 8-second physically photographed architectural camera shot from the supplied start image to the supplied end image. The start and end show the SAME fixed site from different viewpoints. CRITICAL: do NOT crossfade, dissolve, ghost, morph or blend these two pictures. Preserve all concrete edges sharply. The concrete upright is opaque with real pores and perspective, never transparent. This is a camera travelling around an architectural obstacle, never through solid concrete. A single fixed tessellated red steel A remains in the forecourt, same silhouette, inner triangle, burgundy/crimson/scarlet panels, bolts and chains; never move it, duplicate it or change its scale except by physical perspective. Rigid supported slabs and walls, natural parallax, actual concrete texture, blue-hour sky and warm strip lights, realistic wet reflections. Smooth expensive motion control, no shake or zoom, restrained ease at the final view. Keep the space for HTML text naturally dark; generate no lettering, UI or sound. portraitOverride.note: Re-encoded from native 1080p sources through Higgsfield; 720/GOP3 versus 864/GOP3 and source compared at 390px. Original camera movement preserved.

processing: Higgsfield sandbox ffmpeg / Pillow. Native sources retained in Higgsfield.

playback.mode: Native scroll, 100ms exponential smoothing and 24fps quantized serialized seeks; decoded frame clock for captions
playback.narrowAndTouchDefault: Automatic scroll-controlled motion; no playback button
playback.hostWithoutByteRanges: Prepare same-origin Blob for current and prefetched moves before crossing
playback.cache: Retain up to three prepared moves per orientation; release old orientation after replacement frame is decoded
playback.prefetch: Next directional move after 30% progress; first move only on entry
playback.reducedMotion: Composed stills; also used for data saving, explicit fallback or video failure
playback.seekPosition: Midpoint of quantized 24fps frame interval to avoid boundary rounding selecting a previous frame
playback.opening: Hold opening pose and caption while first film prepares; 180ms same-pose opacity handoff, then smooth toward pending native scroll destination.

sharing.processing: Higgsfield sandbox Pillow ImageOps.fit, Lanczos, centered crop, RGB, optimized JPEG. Faithful derivative of the approved landscape anchor; no new generation or project-photo claim.

portraitFrameSequence.format: ADFC magic; uint32LE frame count; count+1 uint32LE payload-relative offsets; concatenated independent WebP images
portraitFrameSequence.opening: opening.webp is the unchanged first WebP payload from 000.bin, unpacked locally; replaces the three old portrait/mobile opening variants to ensure the exact same pixels and color at handoff.
portraitFrameSequence.note: Existing accepted footage, including repaired joins. No new generation or frame interpolation. Progressive packet loading; bounded decoded cache; video retained for landscape/unsupported ImageBitmap.
